fuse_conv_affine: fuse Conv or ConvTranspose layers with AffineChannel batch norm ops in a Caffe2 net
generate_init_net: generate a Caffe2 initialization net proto from a dictionary of named numpy blob tensors
compare_two_models: compare outputs of two Caffe2 model functions on a test image and check blob equality
save_net_graph: save a Caffe2 net definition as a PNG graph image using pydot for visualization
filter_ops: filter Caffe2 operators by type, inputs, outputs, or custom conditions using OpFilter
